nodes.label: Inline glossary feature
nodes.rationale: Bilingual (EN/HE) tap-for-definition popovers for beginner vocabulary, matched with real word boundaries; Hebrew needed pre-expanded prefix forms since it attaches prefixes with no space.

nodes.label: GlossaryScope dedup-via-useRef bug
nodes.rationale: GlossaryScope shared its dedup Set through a useRef that survived re-renders: after the first render every term was already 'claimed', so the glossary silently stopped marking anything on any subsequent re-render. Page-level tests only asserted prose text was present, which stayed true even with marking off, so the bug shipped undetected.

nodes.label: highlightGlossaryGroup (pure function fix)
nodes.rationale: Replaced GlossaryScope/context with a pure function taking all related text blocks at once, so dedup state lives and dies inside one call and the same input always gives the same output regardless of React re-renders.

nodes.label: Bundle split (lazy-load AI/KB engine)
nodes.rationale: Main chunk went 675kB to 324kB (gzip 220kB to 107kB) by moving the engine+KB behind a lazy() boundary shared by Stock/Compare/AI routes; lazy-loading the AI route alone did nothing because the KB has a second eager import path through market/stockLookup and matchingEngine.

nodes.label: @core/ai/ambientTopic.js module
nodes.rationale: Extracted as a zero-dependency module so AiLauncher (which renders on every route and is never lazy) could call setAmbientLessonTopic without pulling the whole ~300kB KB back into the eager main chunk.

nodes.label: AI engine exhaustive QA sweep (1105 questions)
nodes.rationale: Every keyword of every one of 165 KB entries asked as its own question in its own language, to catch phrasing-specific routing bugs that spot-checking would very likely miss.

nodes.label: Ticker alias hijacking bug (cost/target)
nodes.rationale: 'cost' (Costco) and 'target' (Target Corp) are bare dictionary words as well as ticker aliases, so ordinary questions like 'dollar cost averaging' were silently answered with live company data instead of the KB topic. Fixed by requiring an explicit company-question signal nearby, unless the alias is the entire message.

nodes.label: FUZZY_TERMS cross-collision bug
nodes.rationale: FUZZY_TERMS is auto-generated from every single-word KB keyword, so unrelated correctly-spelled words within edit-distance 2 (correlation/correction, stocks/stonks) manufactured bonuses for each other. Fixed generally in fuzzyBonus: a word already known as a real KB term is never treated as a possible typo of a different term.

nodes.label: kbCoverage.test.ts
nodes.rationale: Kept as a permanent regression test running the full 1105-question sweep, not a one-off; also encodes FACET_OVERRIDES for the 8 cases where a parent entry deliberately loses to a child's keyword.

nodes.label: ChartCard odd-card gallery layout fix
nodes.rationale: An odd number of example charts left the last card alone in a 2-column grid. Fixed by capping the grid at 2 columns, computing which card is actually left trailing (accounting for a leading full-row aside card), and centering the lone card at normal width via a new spanFull prop rather than stretching it.

nodes.label: prose.ts authored-content rule
nodes.rationale: prose.ts's own header states lesson content is authored teaching content, not copy to rewrite on a styling pass — respected across every pass in this engagement.

nodes.label: Quiz advanced question before Next bug
nodes.rationale: submitAnswer incremented currentIndex on the same session object in place, so reading currentQuestion during render returned the next question while the learner was still reading the explanation. Fixed by holding the displayed question in view state and advancing only on Next.

nodes.label: Hebrew glossary substring match bug
nodes.rationale: Plain substring matching let a short Hebrew term match inside a longer unrelated word sharing its root, since JS's \w excludes Hebrew entirely so \b doesn't work. Fixed with a real Hebrew word boundary, pinned by test for both reported cases plus all 109 existing surface forms.

nodes.label: ui/utils/popoverPlacement.ts
nodes.rationale: Glossary popover clipping (site-wide, not just mobile) fixed by rendering as a body portal with real pixel placement computed from getBoundingClientRect, clamped to viewport; placement math extracted to this pure module so it is unit-testable without a real DOM.

nodes.label: Duplicate risk-reward-ratio KB entry bug
nodes.rationale: risk-reward-ratio was authored independently as a full entry in two KB files (risk.js and focused.js); kbById silently resolved to whichever loaded last, while topicsInCategory rendered both as duplicate buttons since it doesn't dedupe the raw array.

nodes.label: MA_PERIODS ReferenceError crash
nodes.rationale: matchingEngine.js imported maBandDescription from ma-periods.js but not MA_PERIODS, which the same function uses two lines later — any moving-average-period question threw ReferenceError.

nodes.label: Core/UI colour-and-language separation rule
nodes.rationale: @core describes annotations by tone and {he,en}; only @ui resolves colour and language. Never put a colour string or a resolved label in @core — listed among the rules that carry forward across all passes.
